name: @w6w-apps/rippling
description: Read and manage Rippling workers, users, org structure, time off and custom objects through the Rippling REST API.

w6w.longDescription:
Rippling is an HR, IT and payroll platform, and its REST API exposes the same employee system of record the product runs on. This app lets a workflow read workers and users, walk the org structure (departments, teams, work locations, employment types, levels, titles and legal entities), and work with time off — listing requests and balances, creating a request, approving or rejecting one by changing its status.

It also reaches Rippling's custom fields and custom objects: list an object's field definitions, query and page through its records, and create, update or delete a record by id or look one up by external id.

Authentication is a Rippling API token, scoped when it is created. What each action returns is bounded by that token's scopes and by its owner's permission profile; fields the token may not see come back as null, and every list action reports exactly which ones in `redactedFields`. Health checks read the Platform API component of Rippling's status page rather than the company-wide indicator, so a Payroll incident does not mark the API as down.
